title: Plagiarize uses the technology dialog
description: Plagiarize: "Spend 5 influence and choose a non-faction technology owned by 1 of your neighbors. Gain that technology." The engine asks the 5 influence first (the standard exhaust-planets payment dialog, unchanged and shown for completeness) and then which technology. That second question was a bespoke option list; it is now the normal technology dialog (filters, tiers, roster) showing only the technologies the engine offers, with a Gain Technology (Free) button. Before shots are taken on the commit without the change; after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- GU. Synthetic fixture through a mocked server: the neighbour owns Gravity Drive, Hyper Metabolism, Sling Relay and Destroyer II.

notes.title: Tech skips
notes.text: Removed: Plagiarize gains the technology outright, with no prerequisites and no resource cost, so skips and the resource tally do not apply.

notes.title: What is offered
notes.text: Exactly what the engine lists (a neighbour's non-faction technologies). The pick is submitted with the engine's option id (neighbour|technology).

notes.title: Open point
notes.text: The engine removes the stolen technology from the neighbour; the old list said 'they keep theirs'. The card text says only 'gain that technology'. Not changed here.
